outcome: effectiveness of SPGB for PDPH management
cohort: One hundred parturients diagnosed with post-dural puncture headache (PDPH) following lower segment cesarean section were recruited.
finding: Bilateral intranasal Sphenopalatine ganglion block (SPGB) demonstrated excellent efficacy as an initial modality for managing severe headaches in patients with post-dural puncture headache (PDPH), with a 15 times faster onset of analgesia compared to conservative treatment.
